Heard the learned counsel appearing for the parties.

2. This appeal is filed by the claimant seeking enhancement of compensation, assailing the judgment and award dated 15.03.2021 in MVC No.1044/2019, on the file of the learned II Additional Senior Civil Judge and Member MACT, Kalaburagi (hereinafter referred to as 'Tribunal'), awarding compensation.

entities.text: II Additional Senior Civil Judge and Member MACT, Kalaburagi
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 3. Having taken note of the submission made by the learned counsel appearing for the parties and the NC: 2026:KHC-K:1051 HC-KAR finding recorded by the Tribunal, it is not in dispute that, the claimant has sustained grievous injuries on account of road traffic accident occurred on 19.11.2018.

The claimant has produced the wound certificate at Exs.P5 and P6 and the disability certificate at Ex.P13 and examined the treating doctor as PW2.
4.
Taking into account the injuries sustained by the claimant, I am of the view that, the Tribunal ought to have taken the disability at 25%.

It is also to be noted that, the accident is of the year 2018 and therefore, as per the guidelines issued by the Karnataka State Legal Services Authority, monthly income of the claimant would be Rs.11,750/-.
By applying the appropriate multiplier of 18, the claimant is entitled for Rs.6,34,500/- (Rs.11,750x12x18x25%) towards loss of future income.

5. Taking into consideration the grievous injuries sustained by the claimant as per Exs.P5 and P6 and the disability certificate at Ex.P13, the award of compensation made by the Tribunal is reassessed as follows:

2 NC: 2026:KHC-K:1051 HC-KAR Heads Amount Pain and suffering Rs.75,000/- Loss of earnings during laid up Rs.70,500/- period (Rs.11,750x6) Loss of amenities Rs.75,000/- Loss of future of earnings Rs.6,34,500/- Towards food and nourishment and Rs.50,000/- attendant charges Towards conveyance charges Rs.25,000/-
Medical expenses Rs.9,98,400/-
Total Rs.19,28,400/-
Less: awarded by Tribunal Rs.14,97,800/-
Enhancement Rs.4,30,600/-
Thus, the clamant is entitled for enhanced compensation of Rs.4,30,600/- with interest at the rate of 6% per annum.

6. In the result, I pass the following:
ORDER I.
The appeal is allowed in part.
NC: 2026:KHC-K:1051 HC-KAR II.
The appellant/claimant is entitled for enhanced compensation of Rs.4,30,600/- with interest at the rate of 6% per annum from the date of petition till the date of realization.
III. Respondent No.2 - Corporation is directed to deposit the compensation amount within six weeks from the date of receipt of certified copy of this judgment.

Sd/-
